qualification.reason: The document is an Expression of Interest (EOI) issued by OhioMHAS for Recovery Month Events funding. It includes a submission deadline, eligibility requirements, and describes a proposed funding opportunity, making it a valid procurement/solicitation document.

quotes.quote: Recovery Month Events – Expression of Interest (EOI)
Request for Applications Due Date: 07/25/2025, by 3 p.m. EDT
OhioMHAS utilizes the EOI to conduct market research to identify organizations interested in participating in a proposed opportunity.
Each eligible organization may request up to $10,000 to plan and implement activities and event(s) focused on any or all the following:

findings.title: Eligible Organization Types
findings.fact: OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be one of the listed organization types to be eligible.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that the organization falls into one of the specified categories.

quotes.quote: OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations.

findings.title: Federal Tax Identification Number Required
findings.fact: Organizations must have a federal tax identification number (FTID).
findings.business_implication: The bidder must possess a valid FTID to be eligible.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure the organization has a valid FTID.

quotes.quote: Organizations must have a federal tax identification number (FTID).

findings.title: 501(c)(3) Non-Profit Status Required
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization to qualify.

findings.title: Eligible Organizations and Funding Amount
findings.fact: OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations. Each eligible organization may request up to $10,000.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must confirm they are a non-profit organization with a federal tax identification number (FTID) and can deliver recovery-focused events within the specified scope.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify organizational eligibility and prepare a proposal for up to $10,000 for eligible activities.

quotes.quote: OhioMHAS is requesting expressions of interest from potential prevention, treatment, and/or recovery supports providers; community coalitions; recovery community organizations; peer run organizations; housing providers; faith-based organizations; schools; and other non-profit community organizations. Organizations must have a federal tax identification number (FTID).
Each eligible organization may request up to $10,000 to plan and implement activities and event(s) focused on any or all the following:

findings.title: Mandatory Minimum Requirements
findings.fact: To qualify, organizations must be 501(c)(3) non-profit, have a federal tax identification number (FTID), and be able to expend funds by September 29, 2025.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be a 501(c)(3) non-profit and have the capacity to fully expend awarded funds by the deadline.
findings.action_recommendation: Confirm 501(c)(3) status and ability to meet expenditure deadline.

quotes.quote: All awards must be fully expended by September 29, 2025.

findings.title: Submission via Microsoft Form
findings.fact: Expressions of interest must be submitted via the Microsoft form at https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7 by July 25th at 3:00 p.m.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must complete the online form before the deadline; no other submission method is mentioned.
findings.action_recommendation: Prepare responses to all questions on the Microsoft form and submit before the deadline.

quotes.quote: To submit your expression of interest please complete all questions on the Microsoft form at https://forms.office.com/g/2YnKfqHta7 by July 25th at 3:00 p.m.

findings.title: First-Come, First-Served Basis
findings.fact: Funding will be provided to organizations on a first-come, first-served basis.
findings.business_implication: Early submission increases the chance of receiving funding.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit the EOI as early as possible after the posting date.

quotes.quote: Funding will be provided to organizations on a first-come, first-served basis.

findings.title: Funding Disbursement via OhioPro
findings.fact: Awarded funds will be disbursed via pass through agent, OhioPro, and organizations will be able to access the full amount once disbursement requirements are met.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must comply with OhioPro disbursement requirements to receive funds.
findings.action_recommendation: Familiarize with OhioPro processes and ensure all disbursement requirements are met.

quotes.quote: Organizations will be able to access the full amount of awarded funds once disbursement requirements are met. Awarded funds will be disbursed, via pass through agent, OhioPro.

findings.title: Reporting Requirements
findings.fact: Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey, due no later than November 7, 2025.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must allocate resources to complete reporting after the event.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for reporting and ensure timely submission of the outcomes survey.

quotes.quote: Organizations are required to report to OhioMHAS how funds were utilized using the OhioMHAS outcomes survey. OhioMHAS will provide the survey link and the SOS questionnaire (if applicable) for required reporting. Completed surveys are due no later than November 7, 2025.

findings.title: One-Time Event Restriction
findings.fact: The event(s) awarded under this funding opportunity will be viewed as one-time only and should not support ongoing services/supports/salaries.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure that funded activities are one-time events and not ongoing programs.
findings.action_recommendation: Design event plans that are clearly one-time and avoid ongoing commitments.

quotes.quote: The event (s) awarded under this funding opportunity will be viewed as one-time only and should not support ongoing services/supports/salaries.
